summary: IBM watsonx.ai's Free Toolbox playground includes up to 300,000 foundation-model tokens per month, up to 20 Compute Usage Hours (CUH) per month of machine-learning tools, and up to 100 text-extraction documents per month.
claim_steps: Create an IBM account and start the free trial from https://www.ibm.com/products/watsonx-ai/pricing.
Use the Free Toolbox playground: foundation models up to 300,000 tokens/month, ML tools up to 20 CUH/month, text extraction up to 100 docs/month.
